nodes.summary: For $n \ge 1$ let $S_n$ be the additive submonoid of $\mathbb{N}$ generated by $n^2, (n+1)^2, (n+2)^2, \ldots$, and let $e(S_n)$ be its embedding dimension, the number of nonzero elements of $S_n$ that are not the sum of two nonzero elements of $S_n$. There is a natural number $C$ with $e(S_n) \le C n$ for all $n \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Semigroups of squares have embedding dimension $O(n)$

nodes.summary: There is a real constant $C > 0$ such that every positive integer $n$ can be written as $n = a_1^2 + a_2^2 + a_3^2 + a_4^2$ with integers $a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4$, each of which is either $0$ or at least $\sqrt{n} / C$.
nodes.title: Four squares with large nonzero parts

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$ be an integer and $\varepsilon > 0$ a real number. For $n \ge 1$ let $S_n$ be the additive submonoid of $\mathbb{N}$ generated by $n^k, (n+1)^k, (n+2)^k, \ldots$. Then there is a real constant $K$ such that for every $n \ge 1$, if $S_n$ has a Frobenius number $F$ (the largest natural number not in $S_n$), then $F \le K n^{k + \varepsilon}$.
nodes.title: Frobenius numbers of semigroups of $k$-th powers are $O(n^{k+\varepsilon})$

conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
